relation: c^2 >= 4 s D, i.e. c >= c* = 2 sqrt(s D)  (no front is slower than the Fisher-KPP minimal speed)
note: The law proves c* is the MINIMUM of the family of linear spreading speeds, so the checkable direction is the lower bound: a committed front speed below 2 sqrt(s D) is inconsistent with the committed selection and dispersal coefficients. 'violated' says those three numbers cannot hold together under the Fisher-KPP hypothesis; it does not say the population spreads too slowly in nature, and it does not establish that a travelling wave exists at all.
